title: The Agent Operator's Handbook
subtitle: A Field Guide to Dispatching, Steering, and Recovering Multiple AI Coding Agents at Once

channelDecision.chosen: own storefront (Stripe Checkout on a house Cloudflare-served property)
channelDecision.reason: meet-then-beat doctrine (owner-ruled 2026-09-01): house digital goods do not route through a marketplace incumbent; Gumroad/Lemon Squeezy/Payhip researched as the incumbent capability census (meet-gap list), not as the selling channel.

meetGaps.status: gap -- requires a webhook-driven signed-URL/email delivery Worker
partial -- Stripe Tax Basic covers calculation/collection only; registration and filing remain the seller's obligation
met and arguably beaten -- Stripe payout has no marketplace-imposed minimum on top
gap -- needs a published policy page; Stripe provides only the mechanics
gap, deferred -- not required for first sale
gap, minor, deferred -- first listing ships fixed-price
structural gap -- addressed by the organic funnel, not by engineering

beatDifferentiator: public, hash-verified build record (exact source commit, exact pandoc build command, exact SHA-256 of the shipped EPUB/PDF) -- a marketplace has no access to our source tree and cannot offer this

funnel.finding: cold paid-traffic acquisition does not clearly break even at $100-$1000/month budgets below ~5% conversion; primary channel is organic (r/ClaudeCode etc., reused from the cohort funnel research), with paid spend better used as warm-traffic retargeting once traffic exists

risks: first release, no reviews yet: the first buyers' feedback goes into the next edition
a refund policy page is needed on the house storefront; merchant-of-record platforms supply their own
launchSteps: list the EPUB and PDF at $29 on Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy, which act as merchant of record and remit VAT/GST
post a free chapter to r/ClaudeCode, Latent Space, and the founder's accounts, linking the listing
add live Stripe keys to the deployed shop Worker so the house storefront sells it too
